# Aprincar

**Aprender acontece brincando.**

Aprincar is an open, local-first platform for playful learning experiences. The organization hosts the platform kernel, official/community games, curriculum adapters and authoring templates.

- Platform: web/PWA, profiles, progress, Skill Graph and extension runtime
- Games: browser extensions connected by the Aprincar Game SDK
- Community: pull-request review, automated security/technical gates and pedagogical review
- Sustainability: donations and optional future institutional infrastructure; child learning is not paywalled
